messages.content: [2026 FIFA World Cup Group F] Group F of the 2026 FIFA World Cup took place from June 14 to 25, 2026. The group consisted of the Netherlands, Japan, Sweden, and Tunisia. The Netherlands topped the group, winning two games and drawing the other. Japan finished as runners-up, winning one game and drawing the other two. Both teams advanced to the round of 32. Sweden finished in third place, and their performance allowed them to advance as one of the eight best third-place teams. However, the three teams performed poorly in the round of 32 and were eliminated from the World Cup. Tunisia were eliminated after losing their first two group games, and would go on to lose their third. | other articles: Guy Stéphan, Ronald Koeman

messages.content:
After the match, Tunisia manager Sabri Lamouchi was relieved from his managing duties.
It was the first time that a manager was sacked during the FIFA World Cup since the 1998 edition when Tunisia’s then manager Henryk Kasperczak and his side lost its first two group stage matches 2–0 to England and 1–0 to Colombia respectively.
